_readme: PROXY BACKGROUND FACTOR PACK — CE-RISE DPP Workbench / WP3 PEFDPP integration.
The PEFDPP case study (Mintjes et al.) carries a COMPLETE machine-readable foreground
life cycle inventory: every activity, every exchange, every quantity, plus CFF parameters
and DQR scores. What it deliberately does NOT carry is the BACKGROUND inventory — the
ecoinvent 3.12 unit processes behind 'aluminium, wrought alloy' or 'electricity, medium
voltage'. Those are commercially licensed and are referenced in the RDF graph by name and
To produce a demonstrable number, this pack supplies ONE published, citable cradle-to-gate
GWP100 value per background flow. Every value carries its tier, source and uncertainty and
is rendered in the UI with a visible 'proxy' badge. NOTHING here is presented as an
EF-compliant result. Swapping this file for a licensed ecoinvent/EF-node extract turns the
same calculation into a compliant one without touching the engine.
A — well-established published value for this exact material/process, low spread
B — published value for a close category proxy
C — order-of-magnitude estimate; treat as indicative only
UNITS: kg CO2e per unit_of_flow, cradle-to-gate.

meta.method_reference: IPCC AR6 GWP100, as adopted in EF 3.1
meta.compliance: NOT EF-compliant. Proxy layer for demonstration only.

electricity_grids._note: Selected per activity using act:hasGeography from the RDF graph. This is the single clearest payoff of a machine-readable LCI: the grid factor is chosen by the graph, not by a human filling in a form. Lifecycle (not direct-combustion) intensities.

NO.source: Norwegian production mix, ~92% hydro (NVE / AIB production mix)

DE.source: German grid mix incl. upstream fuel chain (UBA / EEA range 0.35-0.45)

ES.source: Spanish grid mix incl. upstream (REE / EEA)

CN.source: Chinese grid mix incl. upstream fuel chain (IEA / ecoinvent CN range 0.60-0.75)

RER.source: European (RER) average grid mix incl. upstream (EEA)

GLO.source: Global average grid mix incl. upstream (IEA)

electricity_grids._uplift_note: Low-voltage delivery adds ~3% for distribution losses relative to medium voltage.

AluminiumWroughtAlloy.source: Primary aluminium wrought alloy, cradle-to-gate (IAI global average / ecoinvent market range 9-13)

Copper.source: Copper cathode/market, cradle-to-gate (ICA / ecoinvent GLO range 3.0-4.5)

AluminiumCollectorFoilForLiIonBattery.source: Primary aluminium plus foil rolling to battery-grade thickness

CopperCollectorFoilForLiIonBattery.source: Copper plus electro-deposition/rolling to battery foil

PolyvinylfluorideKg.source: Fluoropolymer binder (PVDF/PVF class), fluorine chemistry is energy intensive

BatterySeparator.source: Polyolefin battery separator film, ecoinvent range 3-5

BatteryManagementSystem.source: Populated printed wiring board assembly, ecoinvent range 25-40

LithiumHexafluorophosphate.source: LiPF6 electrolyte salt; fluorine chemistry, ecoinvent range 12-20

VinylCarbonate.source: Speciality carbonate additive, proxied on organic carbonate chemistry

AmmoniumNitrate.source: Ammonium nitrate, as N (Fertilizers Europe / ecoinvent)

SodiumHydroxide.source: NaOH 100%, chlor-alkali membrane cell (Euro Chlor / ecoinvent)

VentingOfNitrogenLiquid.source: Liquid nitrogen from air separation unit (ecoinvent)

LimeProductionTechnologyMix.source: Lime, technology mix incl. calcination CO2 (EuLA / ecoinvent)

QuicklimeProductionTechnologyMix.source: Quicklime (CaO), technology mix incl. calcination CO2 (EuLA)

TapWater.source: Tap water at user, ~0.30 kg CO2e/m3 (ecoinvent)

ImpactExtrusionOfAluminium1Stroke.source: Impact extrusion of aluminium, 1 stroke — processing only (ecoinvent)

HeatDistrictOrIndustrialNaturalGas.source: Heat, district/industrial, natural gas, incl. upstream (ecoinvent)

SteamFromNaturalGas.source: Industrial steam from natural gas boiler, incl. upstream

ThermalEnergyFromNaturalGas.source: Thermal energy from natural gas, incl. upstream

ThermalEnergyFromLightFuelOil.source: Thermal energy from light fuel oil, incl. upstream

TransportFreightLorry3575MetricTonDiesel.source: Lorry 3.5-7.5 t, EURO4 — small-truck class, incl. upstream diesel (ecoinvent / GLEC)

LandfillInertWaste.source: Sanitary landfill, inert waste — operations only (ecoinvent)

LandifllOfInertSlag.source: Landfill of inert slag — operations only (ecoinvent). NB: flow type label is misspelled in the source graph; preserved verbatim for traceability.

TreatmentOfElectronicsScrapMetalsRecover.source: Electronics scrap to copper smelter, treatment burden (ecoinvent)

flow_factors._cff_note: Erec_EoL terms of the Circular Footprint Formula — the burden of the recycling process itself, excluding the credited virgin material it displaces.

AluminiumRecycling.source: Secondary aluminium remelting, process burden only (ecoinvent / IAI)

CopperRecycling.source: Secondary copper refining, process burden only (ICA)

SteelRecycling.source: EAF steel recycling, process burden only (worldsteel)

PolymerRecycling.source: Mechanical polymer recycling, process burden only

cff_defaults._note: PEF Circular Footprint Formula parameters NOT carried in the case study graph. R2 (recycling rate), R3 (energy recovery rate), the virgin equivalent, the recycling flow and the disposal flow ARE carried in the graph and always win over these defaults.

A.source: PEF Annex C default allocation factor A for metals; CFB-EV §7.3.1

A_polymer.source: PEF Annex C default allocation factor A for plastics

R1.source: Recycled content not declared in the case study graph; conservatively set to 0. A DPP that declares recycled content would populate flow:recycledContentRate and this default would not be used.

Qs_Qp.source: Quality ratio of secondary to primary material, PEF default 1.0 for closed-loop metals

B.source: Energy recovery allocation factor; no energy recovery declared (R3 = 0 for all flows in this case study)
